name: Griffith Business School Next Step Scholarship
summary: Up to $5,000 for first-time students facing educational disadvantage starting a Griffith Business School degree.
key: Maximum value of the scholarship is $5,000 for one year or 80 credit points.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder.
Applying for university study for the first time.
GBS degree as first preference on QTAC or UAC.
how: Apply through Griffith's online scholarship application process.
catches: Not available with another Griffith-funded scholarship.

source.label: Griffith University: GBS Next Step Scholarship

evidence.quote: Maximum value of the scholarship is $5,000 for one year or 80 credit points (equivalent to $625 per 10 credit points).
